entries.summary: Fix: the hosted Host (examples/hosted-bot-collaboration) now enforces Bot autonomy as the local Host does. An observing Bot records would-do entities instead of running create_routine, a cross-Bot delegate or room_call. A Host that vendors the example runs HostedCollaborationStore.migrate() once on every existing schema before the new code serves (it replaces entity_kind_check and moves any wouldDo rows left in a scope frame by an older L import into would_do entity rows), then calls setBotAutonomy(credential, botId, 'auto') for each Bot that must keep acting on its own.
